messages:
ash: Giving away a gently used reclining office chair (grey fabric) + a 27" 1440p monitor (one HDMI, one DP). Moving cross-country next week, need gone by Thursday. Pickup from SoMa. DM if you want either.

jordyn: Pics? :)

ash: Posted pics in DM — chair has a tiny stain on armrest but overall great. Chair wheels replaced last month. Monitor has one tiny scratch near bottom bezel, works perfectly.

kyle: I can take the monitor if still available. Will bring a small box and some bubble wrap.

ash: Awesome @kyle, DM to coordinate time. Chair is first-come in thread here.

nina: I could take the chair but can only pick up after 6pm. Is that ok?

ash: Building pickup hours are 518pm weekdays. If you can do 5:45pm on Wed I can meet in lobby. Otherwise I'll list it on FB marketplace Fri morning.

facility-bot: FYI — Reminder: all lobby pickups must be logged with concierge. Please provide recipient name and show ID.

jordyn: If @nina can't make 5:45, I can pick up and drop at my place (near 16th) and hold for you. Quick handoff.

nina: @jordyn youre a lifesaver. Would you? I can Venmo $10 for the trouble.

jordyn: No need, just coffee next time. :)

kyle: Quick q — monitor stand included?

ash: Monitor is VESA-mounted to a cheap riser, but Ill remove the riser. No fancy arm included.

ash: Update: @kyle monitor claimed; @nina please DM @jordyn to confirm the 5:45pm pickup tomorrow. If anyone wants a small pack of spare HDMI and DP cables I can toss them in.

nina: DMing now. Thanks everyone.

ash: If chair still here after Friday I'll donate to Goodwill or put it on curb. Thanks!
